title: Provider-neutral onboarding readiness
summary: Explore concise onboarding and read-only readiness diagnostics for compatible connector-only and shell hosts: scope, permissions, installation pin, supported capabilities and next safe action. Document real qualified environments without requiring a provider.

origin.source: Owner-directed VIB engineering research and independent implementation discussion, 2026-11-25; source-level provenance retained separately.

benefits: Reduces setup ambiguity and improves portability
risks: Documentation is not independent-host acceptance; no mandatory plugin, paid runner or automatic install

evidence.claim: Existing VIB candidate context only; does not establish implementation or acceptance of this idea.
